snippet.title: Model Car Shop Simulator on Steam
snippet.description:
Diecast Shop Simulator lets you manage a diecast model store.
Wishlist Now:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3481370/Diecast_Shop_Simulator/

 Organize shelves, assist customers, and expand your shop in a detailed, realistic world. Hunt for rare and chase cars, trade with customers, and grow your diecast empire.

Are you a hotwheels , minigt or other diecast model cars fan ?
